title: Ireland's Fiscal Surplus Masks a Battle Over Who Benefits From the Recovery · 19 Oct
keywords: Ireland, Budget 2027, public-sector pay, strike action, cost of living, fiscal surplus, inflation, trade unions, Irish economy, EU fiscal policy, childcare, income tax, carbon tax, industrial relations
notes: Ireland's government is sitting on projected surpluses worth billions of euros, yet hundreds of thousands of public-sector workers are striking and households say they cannot feel the improvement. Budget 2027 and an unresolved pay dispute have together crystallised the country's central political tension: a state with fiscal room facing citizens who argue that prosperity has not reached them. The coming weeks will test whether generous finances can translate into durable political and economic stability.
